quests.instruction: Which small vehicle has three wheels and pedals, perfect for young children?
quests.hint: Think about the three-wheeled ride young children pedal before they learn to ride a bike.
quests.explanation: A tricycle is a small vehicle with three wheels and pedals. Tricycles are easy for young children to balance on!
quests.funFact: Having three wheels instead of two makes a tricycle much easier to balance on!

quests.instruction: Which old-fashioned vehicle with wheels was pulled along by horses?
quests.hint: Think about the fancy vehicle a princess might ride in, pulled by a team of horses.
quests.explanation: A carriage is a wheeled vehicle pulled by horses. Long ago, carriages were a common way to travel!
quests.funFact: Before cars were invented, carriages pulled by horses were the main way people traveled long distances!

quests.instruction: Which simple wheeled vehicle is pulled or pushed to carry goods from place to place?
quests.hint: Think about a basic wheeled vehicle a market seller might push to carry fruits and vegetables.
quests.explanation: A cart is a simple wheeled vehicle used to carry goods. Carts can be pulled by animals or pushed by hand!
quests.funFact: Carts are one of the oldest kinds of wheeled vehicles people have ever used!

quests.instruction: Which old-fashioned vehicle rides on tracks through a city, powered by wires overhead?
quests.hint: Think about a classic vehicle that rings a bell and rides on tracks down a city street.
quests.explanation: A trolley is a vehicle that rides on tracks through a city, powered by overhead wires. Trolleys carry passengers around town!
quests.funFact: Many trolleys ring a friendly bell to let people know they are coming!

quests.instruction: Which super-fast airplane is powered by a powerful engine that roars?
quests.hint: Think about the fastest kind of airplane, powered by a loud, powerful engine.
quests.explanation: A jet is a very fast airplane powered by a powerful engine. Jets can fly much faster than older airplanes!
quests.funFact: A jet engine works by pushing hot air out the back at incredible speed!

quests.instruction: Which fancy, comfortable boat do people use for relaxing trips on the water?
quests.hint: Think about a fancy, comfortable boat families might use for a relaxing vacation at sea.
quests.explanation: A yacht is a fancy, comfortable boat used for relaxing trips. Yachts are often used for vacations on the water!
quests.funFact: Some yachts are so large they even have bedrooms and kitchens on board!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle has only one wheel and takes great balance to ride?
quests.hint: Think about the tricky one-wheeled ride you might see a performer balancing on at a circus.
quests.explanation: A unicycle is a vehicle with just one wheel. Riding a unicycle takes wonderful balance and lots of practice!
quests.funFact: Circus performers often ride unicycles to show off their amazing sense of balance!

quests.instruction: Which bright yellow bus picks up children and drives them to school every morning?
quests.hint: Think about the bright yellow bus that stops right outside your house every school morning.
quests.explanation: A school bus is a bright yellow bus that carries children to school. School buses stop at each child's home!
quests.funFact: School buses are painted bright yellow because that color is easy to see from far away!

quests.instruction: Which truck has an open back area for hauling tools, dirt, or furniture?
quests.hint: Think about a truck with a covered front for the driver and an open back for hauling things.
quests.explanation: A pickup truck is a truck with an open back area. Pickup trucks haul tools, dirt, and furniture!
quests.funFact: A pickup truck's open back is called the truck bed!

quests.instruction: Which super-fast, low car zooms around a special track to win a competition?
quests.hint: Think about the sleek, speedy car that zooms around a racetrack, trying to finish first.
quests.explanation: A race car is a fast, low car built for racing. Race cars zoom around a track to see who finishes first!
quests.funFact: Some race cars can go faster than three hundred kilometers per hour!

quests.instruction: Which sleek, speedy car is built low to the ground for a fast, fun ride?
quests.hint: Think about a sleek car, lower and faster-looking than a regular family car.
quests.explanation: A sports car is a sleek, speedy car built low to the ground. Sports cars are designed to drive very fast!
quests.funFact: Sports cars are built low to the ground to help them turn corners smoothly and quickly!

quests.instruction: Which roomy vehicle has sliding doors and plenty of seats for a big family?
quests.hint: Think about the roomy vehicle with sliding side doors, perfect for a family road trip.
quests.explanation: A minivan is a roomy vehicle with sliding doors and lots of seats. Families use minivans for road trips!
quests.funFact: A minivan's sliding doors make it easy for children to safely climb in and out!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle hangs from a cable and carries people up and down a steep hill?
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle that dangles from a strong cable, carrying people up a steep mountain.
quests.explanation: A cable car is a vehicle that hangs from a cable. Cable cars carry people up and down steep hills!
quests.funFact: A famous city cable car system has been carrying passengers up steep hills for over a hundred years!

quests.instruction: Which train balances and travels along just a single rail?
quests.hint: Think about a smooth train that glides along only one single track instead of two.
quests.explanation: A monorail is a train that travels on a single rail. Monorails glide smoothly above busy streets!
quests.funFact: The word monorail comes from mono, meaning one, and rail, meaning track!

quests.instruction: Which giant ship carries thousands of vacationing passengers with pools and theaters on board?
quests.hint: Think about an enormous ship that feels like a floating hotel full of fun activities.
quests.explanation: A cruise ship is a giant ship for vacationing passengers. Cruise ships have pools, theaters, and restaurants on board!
quests.funFact: Some cruise ships are so huge they can carry more than five thousand passengers at once!

quests.instruction: Which small boat has a powerful motor and skims quickly across the water?
quests.hint: Think about a small, zippy boat with a loud motor that skims fast across a lake.
quests.explanation: A speedboat is a small boat with a powerful motor. Speedboats zip quickly across the water!
quests.funFact: A speedboat's flat bottom helps it skim on top of the water instead of pushing through it!

quests.instruction: Which tough, boxy vehicle can drive over rocks, mud, and bumpy trails?
quests.hint: Think about a rugged, boxy vehicle built for driving off the road, over rocks and mud.
quests.explanation: A jeep is a tough, boxy vehicle built for rough trails. Jeeps can drive over rocks, mud, and bumpy ground!
quests.funFact: Jeeps were first built to help people travel over rough, difficult ground!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle has a bed and tiny kitchen inside, so a family can sleep on a road trip?
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle that is like a tiny home on wheels for a family road trip.
quests.explanation: A camper is a vehicle with a bed and kitchen inside. Families sleep and cook inside a camper during road trips!
quests.funFact: A camper lets a family bring their bed and kitchen wherever their road trip takes them!

quests.instruction: Which truck plays cheerful music and sells cold, sweet treats on a hot day?
quests.hint: Think about the truck that plays a happy jingle as it drives slowly through the neighborhood.
quests.explanation: An ice cream truck is a truck that sells cold treats. Ice cream trucks play cheerful music as they drive around!
quests.funFact: The cheerful jingle from an ice cream truck can often be heard from blocks away!

quests.instruction: Which small wheeled seat does a grown-up push to carry a baby around?
quests.hint: Think about the wheeled seat a parent pushes to take a baby for a walk.
quests.explanation: A stroller is a small wheeled seat for a baby. A grown-up pushes a stroller to take a baby for a walk!
quests.funFact: Strollers can fold up small so they are easy to carry and store!

quests.instruction: Which wheeled chair helps a person move around when walking is difficult?
quests.hint: Think about a special chair with big wheels that a person can roll themselves in.
quests.explanation: A wheelchair is a wheeled chair that helps a person move around. Wheelchairs can be pushed or rolled by the rider!
quests.funFact: Some wheelchairs have special wheels that let a rider move around all by themselves!

quests.instruction: Which special shoes have wheels attached, letting you glide and roll along?
quests.hint: Think about shoes with small wheels on the bottom that let you glide smoothly along a path.
quests.explanation: Roller skates are special shoes with wheels attached. We glide and roll along the ground while wearing roller skates!
quests.funFact: Roller skates were first invented so people could practice ice skating even in the summer!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle glides quickly over deep snow using a track instead of wheels?
quests.hint: Think about a fast vehicle with skis in front, built especially for zooming over snow.
quests.explanation: A snowmobile is a vehicle built to glide over deep snow. Snowmobiles use skis and a track instead of wheels!
quests.funFact: A snowmobile's wide track helps it grip the snow without sinking in!

quests.instruction: Which small, quiet electric cart carries players and their clubs around a golf course?
quests.hint: Think about the small, slow electric cart that carries players between holes on a golf course.
quests.explanation: A golf cart is a small electric cart for golf courses. Golf carts quietly carry players and their clubs!
quests.funFact: Most golf carts run on quiet electric batteries instead of a loud engine!

quests.instruction: Which loud truck drives down the street each week to collect and crush trash?
quests.hint: Think about the big truck that stops at every house to empty the trash bins.
quests.explanation: A garbage truck is a truck that collects trash. Garbage trucks drive down streets each week to empty the bins!
quests.funFact: A garbage truck can crush and compact trash to fit much more inside!

quests.instruction: Which big truck can tip up its back to dump out sand, dirt, or rocks?
quests.hint: Think about the big truck whose back end tilts up high to slide a heavy load out.
quests.explanation: A dump truck is a big truck that can tip up its back. Dump trucks carry and dump sand, dirt, and rocks!
quests.funFact: A dump truck's back lifts up high so its heavy load slides right out!

quests.instruction: Which truck hooks onto broken-down cars and pulls them safely away?
quests.hint: Think about the truck that comes to help when a car stops working on the road.
quests.explanation: A tow truck is a truck that hooks onto broken-down cars. Tow trucks pull cars that will not start!
quests.funFact: A tow truck uses a strong hook and cable to lift and pull another vehicle safely!

quests.instruction: Which truck drives around town dropping off packages at people's doors?
quests.hint: Think about the truck that brings a package right to your front door.
quests.explanation: A delivery truck is a truck that drops off packages. Delivery trucks bring boxes right to people's doors!
quests.funFact: A single delivery truck might drop off packages at over one hundred homes in one day!

quests.instruction: Which two-wheeled vehicle balances itself and moves when you lean forward?
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle you stand on that balances itself and rolls when you gently lean.
quests.explanation: A Segway is a self-balancing vehicle with two wheels. It moves forward when the rider gently leans forward!
quests.funFact: A Segway uses hidden sensors to balance itself many times every single second!

quests.instruction: Which long, narrow boat is guided through canals by a rower standing at the back?
quests.hint: Think about a slim, elegant boat guided through quiet canals by a rower using one long pole.
quests.explanation: A gondola is a long, narrow boat guided through canals. A rower stands at the back to steer it with a pole!
quests.funFact: Gondolas are famously used to glide through the canals of a beautiful floating city!
